comparison.objective: Insert a stripped conductor into a rail terminal and tighten its clamp screw; the candidate sets and jam-nut-locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-return conductor seated while repeatedly driving one screw; candidate counterholds the adjustment screw with one tool while tightening a concentric nut with another.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct conductor insertion, clamp-down, tightness, and tool withdrawal; candidate requires preserving a 90° adjustment, both nuts retained, and three repeatable cycles.
comparison.reason: This record shares bimanual holding and screwdriver regrasping, but explicitly has no driver reaction torque and does not test locknut-induced setting drift or post-lock cyclic retention.
